ops.title: codex plugin is autobump-guarded; hook-only merges need a v* tag to ship
ops.body: plugin-autobump runs with guard-plugins 'codex slop-cop' and logs 'plugin codex drifted but is guarded (binary-pinned); not bumping' (run on 80b8161, PR #182). The codex version moves only when a v* tag push runs codex-release.yml, whose descriptor job commits 'chore(codex): sync codex-ask.binrun + manifest to vX'. Merged hook changes under plugins/codex/capt-hook stay unreleased until the next tag.
